_metadata.description: Ingredient synergy clusters with evidence tiers and citations

clusters.name: Vitamin D + K2 Calcium Optimization
clusters.mechanism: K2 activates osteocalcin, directing calcium to bone rather than soft tissue. D3 enhances K2 absorption.

clusters.name: Magnesium + Vitamin B6 + Calcium
clusters.mechanism: B6 enhances magnesium absorption and utilization. Magnesium regulates calcium homeostasis.

clusters.name: Omega-3 + Vitamin E
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin E prevents oxidation of omega-3 fatty acids, improving bioavailability and stability.

clusters.name: Iron + Vitamin C
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin C reduces iron to ferrous form, dramatically enhancing absorption. Synergistic effect is well-established.

clusters.name: Probiotics + Prebiotic Fiber (Inulin/FOS)
clusters.mechanism: Prebiotics selectively feed beneficial bacteria, amplifying probiotic colonization and survival.

clusters.name: Turmeric (Curcumin) + Black Pepper (Piperine)
clusters.mechanism: Piperine inhibits glucuronidation and increases intestinal absorption of curcumin by up to 2000%.

clusters.name: Zinc + Copper
clusters.mechanism: Copper is required for zinc absorption and utilization. Optimal ratio is 8:1 (Zn:Cu).

clusters.name: Folate + Vitamin B12 + B6 (Homocysteine Support)
clusters.mechanism: All three are required for homocysteine metabolism. Deficiency in any creates methylation dysfunction.

clusters.name: Astaxanthin + Vitamin C + Vitamin E
clusters.mechanism: Antioxidant synergy: astaxanthin is regenerated by vitamins C and E, extending its activity.

clusters.name: Ginkgo + Gotu Kola (Cognition Support)
clusters.mechanism: Both enhance cerebral blood flow and neural protection through complementary mechanisms.
